keyFindings.description: The selected-[] entry names only the ask routes. It does not name the event logs (GET /api/v1/issues/{key}/events, the artifact events route) or GET /api/v1/events, whose answer and previous_answer this delta also changes from null to []. The architect's acceptance send-back carries this fix.
Wording: 'at the source's end' means one cut at its end; search.e2e.ts:228 says 'in AskHitStatus' where it means 'beside'. The architect's send-back carries both.
The expected value is built with markdownHead's own regex, so a mistake in that regex would be copied into the expectation. Use a fixed expected value (architect's send-back).

The live-frame half repeats coverage that TestLiveAskEventFrameCarriesTheReadTimeFields already gives; the live relay reads through readEventsAfterID like the catch-up. Drop it (architect's send-back).

normalizeAnsweredSelected decodes each ask.answered payload a second time, strictly. Every writer marshals model.AskAnswer and no migration rewrites answers, so no stored payload can fail it. The architect accepts this as it is.
